final: SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, AVG(diff) as avg_difference FROM (SELECT t1.observstation, t1.avg_bandusagepct, t1.avg_bandusagepct - t2.overall_avg as diff FROM (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandusagepct FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) t1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandusagepct FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation)) t2 WHERE t1.avg_bandusagepct > t2.overall_avg)
